The ROG Strix Arion and the TUF Gaming A1 are two portable SSDs with very similar performance, and, in fact, the choice is limited to the aesthetics and endurance factor. Stay Cool, Stay Fast.

  • Up to 10 Gbps

  • Aggressive heat dissipation

  • Support M.2 PCIE NVMe SSD

  • Dual USB cables

ROG Strix Arion is an SSD enclosure that fits an M.2 PCIe NVM Express® SSD with a 2230/2242/2260/2280 form factor and features USB-C™ 3.2 Gen 2x1 connectivity to deliver data transfer speeds of up to 10 Gbps*. Its sleek aluminum alloy case features thermal pads for excellent heat dissipation, exclusive ASUS Aura Sync lighting  effects, and a protective holder with an R-hook that altogether make ROG Strix Arion a high-performance, mobile storage solution.


*Actual data transmission speeds may vary depending on usage situation.

Support M.2 PCIe NVM Express® SSD

ROG Strix Arion fits* 2230/2242/2260/2280 M.2 PCIe NVM Express® SSD up to 2TB with M key/ B+M key. **

*ROG Strix Arion does not support SATA-based B key/ B+M Key and PCIe/ACHI-based M key.
**ROG Strix Arion currently does not support Micron P5 SSD and Realtek RTS5765DL/RTS5766DL controllers, such as but not limited to ADATA SWORDFISH and ADATA XPG SPECTRIX S20G.

Aggressive heat dissipation

An aluminum alloy case with included thermal pads reduce operating temperatures drastically, enabling your SSD to maintain high transfer speeds and extending its longevity.

Innovative screwdriver-free installation

ROG Strix Arion features a pin-design and thumbscrew-installation system that makes it easy to mount your SSD into the enclosure. No screwdriver is required.

Dual USB-C to C and USB-C to A cables

ROG Strix Arion comes with both USB-C to USB-C  and USB-C to USB-A cables for greater convenience and compatibility with a wide range of devices, including laptops, smartphones*, PC, and gaming consoles.

  • USB-C to C cable

  • USB-C to A cable

*For more information about iOS support, please refer to this link

.

Exclusive hanging protective holder

A protective holder with a stylish, detachable R-hook offers protection from bumps and hard hits to keep your SSD operating properly.

ASUS Aura Sync lighting effects

With exclusive ASUS Aura Sync lighting technology, ROG Strix Arion provides ambient lighting that perfectly complements your gaming rig for true expression of your individuality.


Embrace Minimalism, Elevate Style

Designed with meticulous attention to detail, this cutting-edge storage solution not only boasts exceptional performance but also elevates your setup with its all-new moon-white printing patterns. Perfect for those seeking a distinct style, ROG Strix Arion Moonlight White sets itself apart with its unique design elements.
